Class BatchCodeRefiner

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.BatchCodeRefiner
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class BatchCodeRefiner extends AnahataToolkit
Structural, member-level Java refinement (the IntelliJ V4 AST-Guided Batch engine).

Applies a batch of CodeRefinementIntents — insert / update / delete / move of whole members — to a single Java file atomically, against the live PSI tree, then optimizes imports and reformats, and returns a unified diff of the change.

This is the IntelliJ port of the NetBeans BatchCodeRefiner. Where NetBeans splices text using WorkingCopy/SourcePositions, IntelliJ mutates the PSI tree directly: member declarations are parsed via PsiJavaParserFacade.createClassFromText(String, PsiElement) (which robustly handles methods, fields, inner classes and initializers) and then added/replaced/deleted. The whole batch runs in one WriteCommandAction on the EDT, so it is a single undoable transaction. Basic text editing remains available via the core Resources toolkit and CodeRefiner; this toolkit is the structure-aware, member-level path.

anahata
